We provide expert analysis and testimony in legal disputes, regulatory proceedings, and business strategy. Our teams apply economic, financial, and analytical expertise to solve complex problems and provide strategic insights for our clients. At The Brattle Group, we bridge the gap between economic theory and real-world application, helping clients make informed decisions in areas such as corporate finance, energy, competition, and regulatory economics.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003chr\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eWHAT IS ECONOMIC CONSULTING?\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eEconomic consulting involves using economic and financial theories, quantitative methods, and data analysis to address legal and business challenges. Consultants work on high-stakes projects, providing expert testimony and strategic advice to law firms, corporations, and government agencies. Our work influences major decisions and outcomes in legal cases and business strategies worldwide.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003chr\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eRESEARCH ANALYST ROLE\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eAs a Research Analyst (RA) at The Brattle Group, you will be integral to our project teams, collaborating with senior consultants and experts. Your responsibilities will include:\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cul\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eQuantitative Models and Solutions:\u003c/strong\u003e You'll build models and create innovative data-based solutions for clients using programming languages, such as R, Python, Stata, SAS, Excel, and VBA (e.g. conducting data and statistical analysis, econometric analysis, building interactive dashboards, etc.).\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eQualitative Research and Literature Review:\u003c/strong\u003e You'll conduct comprehensive research, including market analysis, literature reviews, document examination, and writing memos to provide insights and support expert reports.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eSupporting Expert Witnesses:\u003c/strong\u003e You'll assist in preparing expert reports and presentations, helping our experts present complex economic and financial concepts clearly in legal and regulatory contexts.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eCollaborating with Team Members:\u003c/strong\u003e Effective communication and teamwork are critical. You'll work closely with colleagues at all levels, contributing to the development of robust and innovative solutions for our clients.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003c/ul\u003e\n\u003chr\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eTYPICAL CASES IN METRICS\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eIn the METRICS practice, you will work on cases such as:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cul\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eAntitrust \u0026amp; Competition:\u003c/strong\u003e Research markets, evaluate any restrictions to competition and, estimate any relevant damages.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eConsumer Protection and Product Liability:\u003c/strong\u003e Identify the effects of misinformation on consumer choice, elicit the value that consumers place on particular product features through the statistical and econometric evaluation of sales data.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eTelecom:\u003c/strong\u003e Conduct analysis related to competition, auctions, and mergers within the telecom industry.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003c/ul\u003e\n\u003chr\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eRA CAREER DEVELOPMENT\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eAt The Brattle Group, your career growth is a priority. As an RA, you will gain valuable skills in applied economics and finance. You'll discover your strengths and interests, and how to best apply your skills. You will be paired with a peer-level colleague and a manager-level career advisor to help you make the most of your time at Brattle. By the end of your first year, you will have learned to conduct basic research, build complex models, collaborate on analysis, present research findings clearly and concisely. You will have also gained experience and aptitude across industries and coding languages.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003chr\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eTHE Research Analyst (Economics) - July 2027
Boston, Massachusetts, United States
Apply

Please submit your application by September 14, 2026. Our secondary deadline is October 12, 2026. We strongly recommend applying by September 14, 2026 to be considered for the Analyst role.

Please note that we will not begin actively contacting candidates for interviews until September 28, 2026.

The Brattle Group is looking for Research Analysts (RAs) to work out of our Boston office.

ABOUT THE BRATTLE GROUP AND ECONOMIC CONSULTING

The Brattle Group is a leading global economic and litigation consulting firm. We provide expert analysis and testimony in legal disputes, regulatory proceedings, and business strategy. Our teams apply economic, financial, and analytical expertise to solve complex problems and provide strategic insights for our clients. At The Brattle Group, we bridge the gap between economic theory and real-world application, helping clients make informed decisions in areas such as corporate finance, energy, competition, and regulatory economics.

WHAT IS ECONOMIC CONSULTING?

Economic consulting involves using economic and financial theories, quantitative methods, and data analysis to address legal and business challenges. Consultants work on high-stakes projects, providing expert testimony and strategic advice to law firms, corporations, and government agencies. Our work influences major decisions and outcomes in legal cases and business strategies worldwide.

RESEARCH ANALYST ROLE

As a Research Analyst (RA) at The Brattle Group, you will be integral to our project teams, collaborating with senior consultants and experts. Your responsibilities will include:

Quantitative Models and Solutions: You'll build models and create innovative data-based solutions for clients using programming languages, such as R, Python, Stata, SAS, Excel, and VBA (e.g. conducting data and statistical analysis, econometric analysis, building interactive dashboards, etc.).
Qualitative Research and Literature Review: You'll conduct comprehensive research, including market analysis, literature reviews, document examination, and writing memos to provide insights and support expert reports.
Supporting Expert Witnesses: You'll assist in preparing expert reports and presentations, helping our experts present complex economic and financial concepts clearly in legal and regulatory contexts.
Collaborating with Team Members: Effective communication and teamwork are critical. You'll work closely with colleagues at all levels, contributing to the development of robust and innovative solutions for our clients.

TYPICAL CASES IN METRICS

In the METRICS practice, you will work on cases such as:

Antitrust & Competition: Research markets, evaluate any restrictions to competition and, estimate any relevant damages.
Consumer Protection and Product Liability: Identify the effects of misinformation on consumer choice, elicit the value that consumers place on particular product features through the statistical and econometric evaluation of sales data.
Telecom: Conduct analysis related to competition, auctions, and mergers within the telecom industry.

RA CAREER DEVELOPMENT

At The Brattle Group, your career growth is a priority. As an RA, you will gain valuable skills in applied economics and finance. You'll discover your strengths and interests, and how to best apply your skills. You will be paired with a peer-level colleague and a manager-level career advisor to help you make the most of your time at Brattle. By the end of your first year, you will have learned to conduct basic research, build complex models, collaborate on analysis, present research findings clearly and concisely. You will have also gained experience and aptitude across industries and coding languages.

THE CANDIDATE

The ideal candidate will possess:

An undergraduate degree in a quantitative discipline (e.g. economics, computer science, data science, and mathematics), with strong academic performance. Successful applicants typically have a GPA of 3.7 or higher (based on a 4.0 scale).
Great teamwork and leadership skills. Our project work is done almost exclusively on teams, so it’s critical that our RAs work well with others.
Intellectual curiosity and creativity. We are looking for candidates who consistently want to learn more and approach problems with creativity.
A high degree of ownership and commitment. Successful RAs are committed to delivering their best work product, taking ownership of their work, and engaging in excellent client services.

Additionally, we look for candidates who:

Have completed or will complete a course in econometrics.
Have completed a significant, self-defined project using quantitative analysis and economic principles.
Can apply quantitative analysis and economic thinking to real-world cases during the interview process.

THE PROCESS

Please submit the following materials through the link below:

Cover letter
Resume
Transcript(s) (unofficial copies accepted)

To streamline the process, please use your school-issued email address on your application.

Brattle offers a competitive benefits package, base salary, and bonus program for eligible roles based on individual and firm performance. The anticipated base gross annual salary for this position in Boston is $97,908.

Brattle will provide H-1B, E3 and TN visa support to full-time candidates who require visa support. Full-time candidates requiring visa support must have or anticipate having a STEM degree upon graduation and must be eligible for at least 36 months of work authorization.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

The Brattle Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, citizenship status, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender identity and expression, age, height, weight, domestic partner status, Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome or HIV status (AIDS/HIV status), genetic information, sexual orientation, disability (where the applicant or employee is qualified to perform the essential functions of the job with or without reasonable accommodation), marital status, veteran status, political affiliation, drug or alcohol abuse or alcoholism, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.

We encourage all applicants to click here to review our full Equal Employer Opportunity Statement.

THE EMPLOYER

The Brattle Group answers complex economic, finance, and regulatory questions for corporations, law firms, and governments around the world. We are distinguished by the clarity of our insights and the credibility of our experts, which include leading international academics and industry specialists. Brattle has 500 talented professionals across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific. For more information, please visit brattle.com​.​​​​​

New York, New York, United States
Apply

Please note that while we accept applications for our internship position starting in the fall, we will not begin actively contacting candidates for interviews until/after November 2026.

Our Summer Internship Opportunity:

This internship program will provide you with the opportunity to apply the economic concepts you’re learning in the classroom in a professional services setting. It will also help you to improve your research and data analysis skills as well as learn to manage and prioritize tasks. You will work side by side with internationally recognized experts in financial economics, corporate finance, energy, competition, and regulatory economics.

METRICS Research Analyst Intern Role

As a Research Analyst intern at The Brattle Group, you will be integral to our project teams, collaborating with senior consultants and experts. Your responsibilities will include:

Quantitative Models and Solutions: You'll build models and create innovative data-based solutions for clients using programming languages, such as R, Python, Stata, SAS, Excel, and VBA (e.g. conducting data and statistical analysis, econometric analysis, building interactive dashboards, etc.).
Qualitative Research and Literature Review: You'll conduct comprehensive research, including market analysis, literature reviews, document examination, and writing memos to provide insights and support expert reports.
Supporting Expert Witnesses: You'll assist in preparing expert reports and presentations, helping our experts present complex economic and financial concepts clearly in legal and regulatory contexts.
Collaborating with Team Members: Effective communication and teamwork are critical. You'll work closely with colleagues at all levels, contributing to the development of robust and innovative solutions for our clients.

Typical Assignments Might Include:

Antitrust & Competition: Research markets, evaluate any restrictions to competition and estimate any relevant damages.
Consumer Protection and Product Liability: Identify the effects of misinformation on consumer choice, elicit the value that consumers place on particular product features through the statistical and econometric evaluation of sales data.
Telecom: Conduct analysis related to competition, auctions, and mergers within the telecom industry.

You will work in a collaborative atmosphere where dedication to project success and individual career and professional development are emphasized. You will have the opportunity to discover where your strengths and interests lie and how you can best apply your skills. The work environment is collegial; and there is significant, on-going contact between senior and junior staff.

The Candidate

The ideal candidates will be pursuing, and possess:

Research Analyst Intern (Economics) - Summer 2027
Washington, District of Columbia, United States
Apply

Please note that while we accept applications for our internship position starting in the fall, we will not begin actively contacting candidates for interviews until/after November 2026.

Our Summer Internship Opportunity:

This internship program will provide you with the opportunity to apply the economic concepts you’re learning in the classroom in a professional services setting. It will also help you to improve your research and data analysis skills as well as learn to manage and prioritize tasks. You will work side by side with internationally recognized experts in financial economics, corporate finance, energy, competition, and regulatory economics.

METRICS Research Analyst Intern Role

As a Research Analyst intern at The Brattle Group, you will be integral to our project teams, collaborating with senior consultants and experts. Your responsibilities will include:

Quantitative Models and Solutions: You'll build models and create innovative data-based solutions for clients using programming languages, such as R, Python, Stata, SAS, Excel, and VBA (e.g. conducting data and statistical analysis, econometric analysis, building interactive dashboards, etc.).
Qualitative Research and Literature Review: You'll conduct comprehensive research, including market analysis, literature reviews, document examination, and writing memos to provide insights and support expert reports.
Supporting Expert Witnesses: You'll assist in preparing expert reports and presentations, helping our experts present complex economic and financial concepts clearly in legal and regulatory contexts.
Collaborating with Team Members: Effective communication and teamwork are critical. You'll work closely with colleagues at all levels, contributing to the development of robust and innovative solutions for our clients.

Typical Assignments Might Include:

Antitrust & Competition: Research markets, evaluate any restrictions to competition and estimate any relevant damages.
Consumer Protection and Product Liability: Identify the effects of misinformation on consumer choice, elicit the value that consumers place on particular product features through the statistical and econometric evaluation of sales data.
Telecom: Conduct analysis related to competition, auctions, and mergers within the telecom industry.

You will work in a collaborative atmosphere where dedication to project success and individual career and professional development are emphasized. You will have the opportunity to discover where your strengths and interests lie and how you can best apply your skills. The work environment is collegial; and there is significant, on-going contact between senior and junior staff.

The Candidate

The ideal candidates will be pursuing, and possess:

An undergraduate degree in a quantitative discipline (e.g. economics, computer science, data science, and mathematics), with strong academic performance. Successful applicants typically have a GPA of 3.7 or higher (based on a 4.0 scale).
Great teamwork and leadership skills. Our project work is done almost exclusively on teams, so it’s critical that our interns work well with others.
Intellectual curiosity and creativity. We are looking for candidates who consistently want to learn more and approach problems with creativity.
A high degree of ownership and commitment. Successful interns are committed to delivering their best work product, taking ownership of their work, and engaging in excellent client services.
Strong communication skills.

To Be Considered for the Research Analyst Intern Position:

Please submit the following materials as soon as possible via the application below.

Cover Letter
Resume
Transcript(s) (unofficial copies accepted)

To streamline the process, please use your school-issued email address on your application.

The anticipated base gross salary for this position in Washington DC is $1,850.00 per week.

The Brattle Group answers complex economic, finance, and regulatory questions for corporations, law firms, and governments around the world. Research Associate
London, England, United Kingdom

Our Research Associates are involved in diverse, challenging assignments within a stimulating, collegial work environment. As a Research Associate in our Competition practice, you will participate in project teams with senior consulting staff and leading industry experts, analysing complex matters such as mergers and acquisitions, antitrust, abuse of dominance, cartels, and class actions. You will have an opportunity to support our Principals, Academic Advisors, and Outside Experts as they serve as expert witnesses before courts and arbitration panels on behalf of law firms, corporations, and government agencies in the US, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and elsewhere.

 

Research Associates at Brattle are experienced professionals who bring valuable expertise and education to our team. This role is ideal for those who have proven excellent analytical skills and are eager to manage and supervise analytical workstreams, training more junior staff and contribute to expert report drafting.

 

Typical assignments include:

Work with the Associate(s) to identify main analytical workstreams
Understand, perform, and supervise statistical/econometric analyses
Supervise day-to-day tasks carried out by more junior staff
Manage auditing and submission process of expert reports to competition authorities, tribunals, etc.
Contribute to the drafting of expert reports, client memos, proposals, presentations, etc.
Give timely feedback, positive and constructive, to junior staff when appropriate
Formally and informally mentor junior staff members
Regularly contribute to firm initiatives, e.g. recruiting, training, and business development

 

The ideal candidate will possess:

Master’s degree in economics or another quantitative discipline along with 3 – 4 years of experience in economic consulting or industry, preferably in the competition and antitrust space
Our project work is done almost exclusively on teams, so it’s critical that our Research Associate’s work well with others
Intellectual curiosity and creativity as we are looking for candidates who consistently want to learn more and approach problems with creativity
A high degree of ownership and commitment. Successful Research Associates are committed to delivering their best work product and taking ownership of their work.
Expertise in Excel as well as other data applications is desired

 

 To be considered for the Research Associate position, please submit the following materials:

CV/resume
Cover letter (describing your interest in economic consulting)
Transcripts

Research Associate - Competition
Sydney, New South Wales, Australia
Apply

Brattle Australia

The Brattle Group, a privately held, global economic consulting firm, is seeking an experienced Research Associate to join our growing competition practice in Sydney. For over a decade, Brattle’s Sydney office has been at the forefront of delivering market-leading corporate finance and economic consulting capabilities across Australia. As we continue to grow, we are looking for talented individuals to join our high-performing team. Our Australia-based professionals work side by side with clients to tackle their most complex challenges, developing novel and rigorous approaches that make a real impact. From assessing economic and commercial damages to shaping innovative solutions and bringing global insights to local markets, we are committed to delivering exceptional analysis and client service—and to building a team where you can do your best work.

Our Work

The competition practice at Brattle in Sydney includes classic competition matters such as mergers and misuses of market power, in addition to other matters requiring a detailed understanding of competition and/or empirical analysis, including estimating damages and market studies. Much of our work involves litigation, but we are also asked to provide consulting assistance in some cases. We work on both the plaintiff/government side and for law firms acting for those accused of anti-competitive conduct.

The Role

Our Research Associates are involved in diverse, challenging assignments within a stimulating, collegial, and fast‑paced work environment. As a Research Associate in our Competition practice, you will participate in project teams with senior consulting staff and leading industry experts, analysing complex matters. You will have an opportunity to support our Principals, Academic Advisors, and Outside Experts as they serve as expert witnesses before courts and arbitration panels on behalf of law firms, corporations, and government agencies.

This role offers clear and structured career progression within the firm, and the individual will work closely with Principals in the office, providing strong visibility, hands-on mentoring, and meaningful opportunities for professional growth. Brattle Research Associates also benefit from continuous formal and informal training and development opportunities.

Research Associates at Brattle are often experienced professionals who bring valuable expertise and education to our team. This role is ideal for those who have proven excellent analytical skills and are eager to manage and supervise analytical workstreams, training more junior staff and contribute to expert report drafting. Over time, you will take on increasing responsibility in leading projects, contributing to client engagement, and developing subject-matter expertise thus building a strong foundation for progression within the firm.

 

The ideal candidate will possess:

4-6 years' experience in economic consulting or a similar environment
An honors degree in economics (or a joint degree with economics)
Strong analytic and quantitative skills (including proficiency with analytical/statistical software such as R and Excel), along with practical problem-solving abilities
Strong relationship building skills
Excellent oral and written communication skills
A desire to work in a collaborative team environment
Demonstrated record of outstanding academic and/or practical accomplishment
An entrepreneurial drive and intellectual curiosity

 

To be considered for the Research Associate position, please submit the following materials:

CV/resume
Cover letter (describing your interest in economic consulting)
Transcripts from all university academic programs

 

THE EMPLOYER

The Brattle Group answers complex economic, finance, and regulatory questions for corporations, law firms, and governments around the world. We are distinguished by the clarity of our insights and the credibility of our experts, which include leading international academics and industry specialists. Brattle has 500 talented professionals across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific. For more information, please visit brattle.com​.​​​​​

Associate – Economics/Finance
Associates work as part of a team on challenging and high-profile projects in a collegial and fast-paced work environment. Brattle is sought after to answer complex financial, economic, and regulatory questions for clients around the world. We provide our Associates with a variety of experiences and individualized development with increasing responsibilities. Associates are central members of each project team and they apply finance, accounting, and economic concepts to help resolve high-profile engagements, including litigation, corporate strategy regulation, and public policy on behalf of our clients`.

 

Associates are responsible for framing research approaches, managing projects, and supervising team/staff while building individual expertise. As they gain valuable hands-on project experience, Associates also become more involved in developing client relationships and marketing and business development efforts. Brattle Associates also benefit from continuous formal and informal training and development opportunities. Brattle is committed to being a multi-generational firm, with many of our Associates developing into Principals and testifying experts.



Ideal Associate Candidates Will Possess

An MBA with an academic or professional background in Economics or Finance, with oil & gas, pipeline, regulatory, or litigation experience.
Excellent foundation in quantitative analysis, and/or several years of relevant work experience (preferably in a consulting, investment banking, asset management, auditing or similar environment)
Demonstrated record of outstanding academic and/or professional accomplishment
Intellectual curiosity, including a drive to think creatively about complex finance, valuation, business strategy, and accounting issues
Excellent analytic and quantitative skills, along with practical problem-solving abilities (including proficiency in Excel; experience with statistical software such as Stata or R also helpful)
An aptitude for, and interest in, expressing complex ideas through written reports and presentations
An entrepreneurial drive to build their own business and brand while contributing to the firm
Desire to work, learn, and lead within a collaborative team environment

 

To be considered for the Associate position, please submit the following materials:

Cover letter that describes your interest in economic and financial consulting and states your location preference
Resume
Undergraduate transcripts and MBA course list (unofficial copies accepted)

 

Brattle offers a competitive benefits package, base salary, and bonus program for eligible roles based on individual and firm performance. The anticipated base gross salary for this position in Toronto, ON is CA$198,900 annually. Actual salary will depend on a variety of factors, including experience and training.

 

THE EMPLOYER

The Brattle Group answers complex economic, finance, and regulatory questions for corporations, law firms, and governments around the world. We are distinguished by the clarity of our insights and the credibility of our experts, which include leading international academics and industry specialists. Brattle has 500 talented professionals across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific. For more information, please visit brattle.com​.​​​​​

Associate – Economics/Finance
Associates work as part of a team on challenging and high-profile projects in a collegial and fast-paced work environment. Brattle is sought after to answer complex financial, economic, and regulatory questions for clients around the world. We provide our Associates with a variety of experiences and individualized development with increasing responsibilities. Associates are central members of each project team and they apply finance, accounting, and economic concepts to help resolve high-profile engagements, including litigation, corporate strategy regulation, and public policy on behalf of our clients`.

 

Associates are responsible for framing research approaches, managing projects, and supervising team/staff while building individual expertise. As they gain valuable hands-on project experience, Associates also become more involved in developing client relationships and marketing and business development efforts. Brattle Associates also benefit from continuous formal and informal training and development opportunities. Associate – Economics/Finance
Associates work as part of a team on challenging and high-profile projects in a collegial and fast-paced work environment. Brattle is sought after to answer complex financial, economic, and regulatory questions for clients around the world. We provide our Associates with a variety of experiences and individualized development with increasing responsibilities. Associates are central members of each project team and they apply finance, accounting, and economic concepts to help resolve high-profile engagements, including litigation, corporate strategy regulation, and public policy on behalf of our clients`.

 

Associates are responsible for framing research approaches, managing projects, and supervising team/staff while building individual expertise. As they gain valuable hands-on project experience, Associates also become more involved in developing client relationships and marketing and business development efforts. Brattle Associates also benefit from continuous formal and informal training and development opportunities. Brattle is committed to being a multi-generational firm, with many of our Associates developing into Principals and testifying experts.



Ideal Associate Candidates Will Possess

An MBA with an academic or professional background in Economics or Finance, with oil & gas, pipeline, regulatory, or litigation experience.
Excellent foundation in quantitative analysis, and/or several years of relevant work experience (preferably in a consulting, investment banking, asset management, auditing or similar environment)
Demonstrated record of outstanding academic and/or professional accomplishment
Intellectual curiosity, including a drive to think creatively about complex finance, valuation, business strategy, and accounting issues
Excellent analytic and quantitative skills, along with practical problem-solving abilities (including proficiency in Excel; experience with statistical software such as Stata or R also helpful)
An aptitude for, and interest in, expressing complex ideas through written reports and presentations
An entrepreneurial drive to build their own business and brand while contributing to the firm
Desire to work, learn, and lead within a collaborative team environment

 

To be considered for the Associate position, please submit the following materials:

Cover letter that describes your interest in economic and financial consulting and states your location preference
Resume
Undergraduate transcripts and MBA course list (unofficial copies accepted)

 

Brattle offers a competitive benefits package, base salary, and bonus program for eligible roles based on individual and firm performance. The anticipated base gross salary for this position in Chicago, IL is $198,900 annually. Actual salary will depend on a variety of factors, including experience and training.

Associate – Economics/Finance
Associates work as part of a team on challenging and high-profile projects in a collegial and fast-paced work environment. Brattle is sought after to answer complex financial, economic, and regulatory questions for clients around the world. We provide our Associates with a variety of experiences and individualized development with increasing responsibilities. Associates are central members of each project team and they apply finance, accounting, and economic concepts to help resolve high-profile engagements, including litigation, corporate strategy regulation, and public policy on behalf of our clients`.

 

Associates are responsible for framing research approaches, managing projects, and supervising team/staff while building individual expertise. As they gain valuable hands-on project experience, Associates also become more involved in developing client relationships and marketing and business development efforts. Brattle Associates also benefit from continuous formal and informal training and development opportunities. Brattle is committed to being a multi-generational firm, with many of our Associates developing into Principals and testifying experts.



Ideal Associate Candidates Will Possess

An MBA with an academic or professional background in Economics or Finance, with oil & gas, pipeline, regulatory, or litigation experience.
Excellent foundation in quantitative analysis, and/or several years of relevant work experience (preferably in a consulting, investment banking, asset management, auditing or similar environment)
Demonstrated record of outstanding academic and/or professional accomplishment
Intellectual curiosity, including a drive to think creatively about complex finance, valuation, business strategy, and accounting issues
Excellent analytic and quantitative skills, along with practical problem-solving abilities (including proficiency in Excel; experience with statistical software such as Stata or R also helpful)
An aptitude for, and interest in, expressing complex ideas through written reports and presentations
An entrepreneurial drive to build their own business and brand while contributing to the firm
Desire to work, learn, and lead within a collaborative team environment

 

To be considered for the Associate position, please submit the following materials:

Cover letter that describes your interest in economic and financial consulting and states your location preference
Resume
Undergraduate transcripts and MBA course list (unofficial copies accepted)

 

Brattle offers a competitive benefits package, base salary, and bonus program for eligible roles based on individual and firm performance. The anticipated base gross salary for this position in Washington, D.C. is $198,900 annually. Actual salary will depend on a variety of factors, including experience and training.

Associate – Economics/Finance
Associates work as part of a team on challenging and high-profile projects in a collegial and fast-paced work environment. Brattle is sought after to answer complex financial, economic, and regulatory questions for clients around the world. We provide our Associates with a variety of experiences and individualized development with increasing responsibilities. Associates are central members of each project team and they apply finance, accounting, and economic concepts to help resolve high-profile engagements, including litigation, corporate strategy regulation, and public policy on behalf of our clients`.

 

Associates are responsible for framing research approaches, managing projects, and supervising team/staff while building individual expertise. As they gain valuable hands-on project experience, Associates also become more involved in developing client relationships and marketing and business development efforts. Brattle Associates also benefit from continuous formal and informal training and development opportunities. Brattle is committed to being a multi-generational firm, with many of our Associates developing into Principals and testifying experts.



Ideal Associate Candidates Will Possess

An MBA with an academic or professional background in Economics or Finance, with oil & gas, pipeline, regulatory, or litigation experience.
Excellent foundation in quantitative analysis, and/or several years of relevant work experience (preferably in a consulting, investment banking, asset management, auditing or similar environment)
Demonstrated record of outstanding academic and/or professional accomplishment
Intellectual curiosity, including a drive to think creatively about complex finance, valuation, business strategy, and accounting issues
Excellent analytic and quantitative skills, along with practical problem-solving abilities (including proficiency in Excel; experience with statistical software such as Stata or R also helpful)
An aptitude for, and interest in, expressing complex ideas through written reports and presentations
An entrepreneurial drive to build their own business and brand while contributing to the firm
Desire to work, learn, and lead within a collaborative team environment

 

To be considered for the Associate position, please submit the following materials:

Cover letter that describes your interest in economic and financial consulting and states your location preference
Resume
Undergraduate transcripts and MBA course list (unofficial copies accepted)

 

Brattle offers a competitive benefits package, base salary, and bonus program for eligible roles based on individual and firm performance. The anticipated base gross salary for this position in San Francisco, CA is $198,900 annually. Actual salary will depend on a variety of factors, including experience and training.

The Brattle Group answers complex economic, finance, and regulatory questions for corporations, law firms, and governments around the world. Associate – Economics/Finance
Associates work as part of a team on challenging and high-profile projects in a collegial and fast-paced work environment. Brattle is sought after to answer complex financial, economic, and regulatory questions for clients around the world. We provide our Associates with a variety of experiences and individualized development with increasing responsibilities. Associates are central members of each project team and they apply finance, accounting, and economic concepts to help resolve high-profile engagements, including litigation, corporate strategy regulation, and public policy on behalf of our clients`.

 

Associates are responsible for framing research approaches, managing projects, and supervising team/staff while building individual expertise. As they gain valuable hands-on project experience, Associates also become more involved in developing client relationships and marketing and business development efforts. Brattle Associates also benefit from continuous formal and informal training and development opportunities. Brattle is committed to being a multi-generational firm, with many of our Associates developing into Principals and testifying experts.



Ideal Associate Candidates Will Possess

An MBA with an academic or professional background in Economics or Finance, with oil & gas, pipeline, regulatory, or litigation experience.
Excellent foundation in quantitative analysis, and/or several years of relevant work experience (preferably in a consulting, investment banking, asset management, auditing or similar environment)
Demonstrated record of outstanding academic and/or professional accomplishment
Intellectual curiosity, including a drive to think creatively about complex finance, valuation, business strategy, and accounting issues
Excellent analytic and quantitative skills, along with practical problem-solving abilities (including proficiency in Excel; experience with statistical software such as Stata or R also helpful)
An aptitude for, and interest in, expressing complex ideas through written reports and presentations
An entrepreneurial drive to build their own business and brand while contributing to the firm
Desire to work, learn, and lead within a collaborative team environment

 

To be considered for the Associate position, please submit the following materials:

Cover letter that describes your interest in economic and financial consulting and states your location preference
Resume
Undergraduate transcripts and MBA course list (unofficial copies accepted)

 

Brattle offers a competitive benefits package, base salary, and bonus program for eligible roles based on individual and firm performance. The anticipated base gross salary for this position in New York, NY is $198,900 annually. Actual salary will depend on a variety of factors, including experience and training.

Associate – Finance/Accounting
Associates work as part of a team on challenging and high-profile projects in a collegial and fast-paced work environment. Brattle is sought after to answer complex financial, economic, and regulatory questions for clients around the world. We provide our Associates with a variety of experiences and individualized development with increasing responsibilities. Associates are central members of each project team and they apply finance, accounting, and economic concepts to help resolve high-profile engagements, including litigation, corporate strategy regulation, and public policy on behalf of our clients.

Associates are responsible for framing research approaches, managing projects, and supervising team/staff while building individual expertise. As they gain valuable hands-on project experience, Associates also become more involved in developing client relationships and marketing and business development efforts. Brattle Associates also benefit from continuous formal and informal training and development opportunities. Brattle is committed to being a multi-generational firm, with many of our Associates developing into Principals and testifying experts.



Ideal Associate Candidates Will Possess

An MBA with an academic or professional background in Finance, Valuation and/or Accounting
Excellent foundation in quantitative analysis, CPA/public accounting experience, and/or several years of relevant work experience (preferably in bankruptcy, forensic accounting, damages, or litigation support)
Demonstrated record of outstanding academic and/or professional accomplishment
Intellectual curiosity, including a drive to think creatively about complex finance, valuation, business strategy, and accounting issues
Excellent analytic and quantitative skills, along with practical problem-solving abilities (including proficiency in Excel; experience with statistical software such as Stata or R also helpful)
An aptitude for, and interest in, expressing complex ideas through written reports and presentations
An entrepreneurial drive to build their own business and brand while contributing to the firm
Desire to work, learn, and lead within a collaborative team environment

 

To be considered for the Associate position, please submit the following materials:

Cover letter that describes your interest in economic and financial consulting and states your location preference
Resume
Undergraduate transcripts and MBA course list (unofficial copies accepted)

 

Brattle offers a competitive benefits package, base salary, and bonus program for eligible roles based on individual and firm performance. The anticipated base gross salary for this position in Chicago, IL is $198,900 annually. Actual salary will depend on a variety of factors, including experience and training.

Associate – Finance/Accounting
Associates work as part of a team on challenging and high-profile projects in a collegial and fast-paced work environment. Brattle is sought after to answer complex financial, economic, and regulatory questions for clients around the world. We provide our Associates with a variety of experiences and individualized development with increasing responsibilities. Associates are central members of each project team and they apply finance, accounting, and economic concepts to help resolve high-profile engagements, including litigation, corporate strategy regulation, and public policy on behalf of our clients.

Associates are responsible for framing research approaches, managing projects, and supervising team/staff while building individual expertise. As they gain valuable hands-on project experience, Associates also become more involved in developing client relationships and marketing and business development efforts. Brattle Associates also benefit from continuous formal and informal training and development opportunities. Brattle is committed to being a multi-generational firm, with many of our Associates developing into Principals and testifying experts.



Ideal Associate Candidates Will Possess

An MBA with an academic or professional background in Finance, Valuation and/or Accounting
Excellent foundation in quantitative analysis, CPA/public accounting experience, and/or several years of relevant work experience (preferably in bankruptcy, forensic accounting, damages, or litigation support)
Demonstrated record of outstanding academic and/or professional accomplishment
Intellectual curiosity, including a drive to think creatively about complex finance, valuation, business strategy, and accounting issues
Excellent analytic and quantitative skills, along with practical problem-solving abilities (including proficiency in Excel; experience with statistical software such as Stata or R also helpful)
An aptitude for, and interest in, expressing complex ideas through written reports and presentations
An entrepreneurial drive to build their own business and brand while contributing to the firm
Desire to work, learn, and lead within a collaborative team environment

 

To be considered for the Associate position, please submit the following materials:

Cover letter that describes your interest in economic and financial consulting and states your location preference
Resume
Undergraduate transcripts and MBA course list (unofficial copies accepted)

 

Brattle offers a competitive benefits package, base salary, and bonus program for eligible roles based on individual and firm performance. The anticipated base gross salary for this position in San Francisco, CA is $198,900 annually. Actual salary will depend on a variety of factors, including experience and training.

Associate, PhD - Early Decision (Finance/Crypto Focus) (2027)
Boston, Massachusetts, United States
Apply

If you are certain that economic consulting is the career path you want to pursue, you should apply through our Early Decision process! If you want to explore other options before making a decision, we welcome you to apply through our regular process via the careers page of our website when the position is posted in October.

We commit to interviewing and making offer decisions to Early Decision candidates no later than December 18, 2026.
The deadline to submit your resume and cover letter to our website is Tuesday, October 13, 2026.
If you are offered a position via our Early Decision process, we will expect your final decision by January 3, 2027 prior to the AEA/ASSA meetings.
We are looking for both new graduates (those who are completing their PhDs by the summer of 2027) as well as experienced PhD’s who have been in the workplace (consulting, government, academia, industry, or other similar field) and are looking to make a change.

 

Associates at The Brattle Group

Associates work as part of a team on challenging and high-profile projects in a collegial and academically-oriented work environment. Brattle is large enough to be sought after to answer some of the most important complex economic, regulatory, and financial questions for clients around the world. We are also small enough to provide our Associates with individualized development and a variety of experiences from our experts. Associates are central members of each project team and apply finance and economic theory and practice to high-profile litigation, corporate strategy, regulation, and public policy issues on behalf of our clients.

Associates are responsible for framing research approaches, managing projects, and supervising team/staff while building individual expertise. As they gain valuable hands-on project experience, Associates also become more involved in developing client relationships and marketing and business development efforts. Brattle Associates benefit from continuous formal and informal training and development opportunities. Many of our Associates develop into Principals and testifying experts.

 

Ideal Candidates Will Possess

PhD in Finance, Financial Economics or related field with a strong foundation in quantitative analysis
Experience in computer science, data analysis, blockchain, and/or crypto markets
Pre- or postgraduate work experience in a related discipline (preferably in finance, government, related industry, or consulting) is strongly desired
Intellectual curiosity
Excellent analytic and quantitative skills (including proficiency with analytical/statistical software such as STATA, R, and Excel), along with practical problem-solving abilities
An entrepreneurial drive
Excellent relationship building skills
Demonstrated proficiency in written and oral communications
Desire to work in a collaborative team environment
Demonstrated record of outstanding academic and/or professional accomplishment

 

To be considered for the Associate position via the Early Decision process, please submit the following materials by Tuesday, October 13, 2026:

Cover letter that describes your interest in economic consulting and states your location preference
CV/resume
A writing sample/research paper 

 

Additional requirements:

If you are a recent graduate, 2-3 references or letters of recommendations should be sent to recruiting@brattle.com. Please note: No other application materials are accepted at this email address

 

Brattle offers a competitive benefits package, base salary, and bonus program for eligible roles based on individual and firm performance. The anticipated base gross salary for this position in Boston, MA is $230,000 annually. Actual salary will depend on a variety of factors, including experience and training.

 

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

The Brattle Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, citizenship status, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender identity and expression, age, height, weight, domestic partner status, Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome or HIV status (AIDS/HIV status), genetic information, sexual orientation, disability (where the applicant or employee is qualified to perform the essential functions of the job with or without reasonable accommodation), marital status, veteran status, political affiliation, drug or alcohol abuse or alcoholism, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.

 

We encourage all applicants to click here to review our full Equal Employer Opportunity Statement.

 

THE EMPLOYER

The Brattle Group answers complex economic, finance, and regulatory questions for corporations, law firms, and governments around the world. We are distinguished by the clarity of our insights and the credibility of our experts, which include leading international academics and industry specialists. Brattle has 500 talented professionals across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific. For more information, please visit brattle.com​.​​​​​

Associate, PhD - Early Decision (Finance/Crypto Focus) (2027)
Chicago, Illinois, United States
Apply

If you are certain that economic consulting is the career path you want to pursue, you should apply through our Early Decision process! If you want to explore other options before making a decision, we welcome you to apply through our regular process via the careers page of our website when the position is posted in October.

We commit to interviewing and making offer decisions to Early Decision candidates no later than December 18, 2026.
The deadline to submit your resume and cover letter to our website is Tuesday, October 13, 2026.
If you are offered a position via our Early Decision process, we will expect your final decision by January 3, 2027 prior to the AEA/ASSA meetings.
We are looking for both new graduates (those who are completing their PhDs by the summer of 2027) as well as experienced PhD’s who have been in the workplace (consulting, government, academia, industry, or other similar field) and are looking to make a change.

 

Associates at The Brattle Group

Associates work as part of a team on challenging and high-profile projects in a collegial and academically-oriented work environment. Brattle is large enough to be sought after to answer some of the most important complex economic, regulatory, and financial questions for clients around the world. We are also small enough to provide our Associates with individualized development and a variety of experiences from our experts. Associates are central members of each project team and apply finance and economic theory and practice to high-profile litigation, corporate strategy, regulation, and public policy issues on behalf of our clients.

Associates are responsible for framing research approaches, managing projects, and supervising team/staff while building individual expertise. As they gain valuable hands-on project experience, Associates also become more involved in developing client relationships and marketing and business development efforts. Brattle Associates benefit from continuous formal and informal training and development opportunities. Many of our Associates develop into Principals and testifying experts.

 

Ideal Candidates Will Possess

PhD in Finance, Financial Economics or related field with a strong foundation in quantitative analysis
Experience in computer science, data analysis, blockchain, and/or crypto markets
Pre- or postgraduate work experience in a related discipline (preferably in finance, government, related industry, or consulting) is strongly desired
Intellectual curiosity
Excellent analytic and quantitative skills (including proficiency with analytical/statistical software such as STATA, R, and Excel), along with practical problem-solving abilities
An entrepreneurial drive
Excellent relationship building skills
Demonstrated proficiency in written and oral communications
Desire to work in a collaborative team environment
Demonstrated record of outstanding academic and/or professional accomplishment

 

To be considered for the Associate position via the Early Decision process, please submit the following materials by Tuesday, October 13, 2026:

Cover letter that describes your interest in economic consulting and states your location preference
CV/resume
A writing sample/research paper 

 

Additional requirements:

If you are a recent graduate, 2-3 references or letters of recommendations should be sent to recruiting@brattle.com. Please note: No other application materials are accepted at this email address

 

Brattle offers a competitive benefits package, base salary, and bonus program for eligible roles based on individual and firm performance. The anticipated base gross salary for this position in Chicago, IL is $230,000 annually. Actual salary will depend on a variety of factors, including experience and training.

 

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

The Brattle Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, citizenship status, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender identity and expression, age, height, weight, domestic partner status, Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome or HIV status (AIDS/HIV status), genetic information, sexual orientation, disability (where the applicant or employee is qualified to perform the essential functions of the job with or without reasonable accommodation), marital status, veteran status, political affiliation, drug or alcohol abuse or alcoholism, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.

 

We encourage all applicants to click here to review our full Equal Employer Opportunity Statement.

 

THE EMPLOYER

The Brattle Group answers complex economic, finance, and regulatory questions for corporations, law firms, and governments around the world. We are distinguished by the clarity of our insights and the credibility of our experts, which include leading international academics and industry specialists. Brattle has 500 talented professionals across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific. For more information, please visit brattle.com​.​​​​​

Associate, PhD - Early Decision (Finance/Crypto Focus) (2027)
Washington, District of Columbia, United States
Apply

If you are certain that economic consulting is the career path you want to pursue, you should apply through our Early Decision process! If you want to explore other options before making a decision, we welcome you to apply through our regular process via the careers page of our website when the position is posted in October.

We commit to interviewing and making offer decisions to Early Decision candidates no later than December 18, 2026.
The deadline to submit your resume and cover letter to our website is Tuesday, October 13, 2026.
If you are offered a position via our Early Decision process, we will expect your final decision by January 3, 2027 prior to the AEA/ASSA meetings.
We are looking for both new graduates (those who are completing their PhDs by the summer of 2027) as well as experienced PhD’s who have been in the workplace (consulting, government, academia, industry, or other similar field) and are looking to make a change.

 

Associates at The Brattle Group

Associates work as part of a team on challenging and high-profile projects in a collegial and academically-oriented work environment. Brattle is large enough to be sought after to answer some of the most important complex economic, regulatory, and financial questions for clients around the world. We are also small enough to provide our Associates with individualized development and a variety of experiences from our experts. Associates are central members of each project team and apply finance and economic theory and practice to high-profile litigation, corporate strategy, regulation, and public policy issues on behalf of our clients.

Associates are responsible for framing research approaches, managing projects, and supervising team/staff while building individual expertise. As they gain valuable hands-on project experience, Associates also become more involved in developing client relationships and marketing and business development efforts. Brattle Associates benefit from continuous formal and informal training and development opportunities. Many of our Associates develop into Principals and testifying experts.

 

Ideal Candidates Will Possess

PhD in Finance, Financial Economics or related field with a strong foundation in quantitative analysis
Experience in computer science, data analysis, blockchain, and/or crypto markets
Pre- or postgraduate work experience in a related discipline (preferably in finance, government, related industry, or consulting) is strongly desired
Intellectual curiosity
Excellent analytic and quantitative skills (including proficiency with analytical/statistical software such as STATA, R, and Excel), along with practical problem-solving abilities
An entrepreneurial drive
Excellent relationship building skills
Demonstrated proficiency in written and oral communications
Desire to work in a collaborative team environment
Demonstrated record of outstanding academic and/or professional accomplishment

 

To be considered for the Associate position via the Early Decision process, please submit the following materials by Tuesday, October 13, 2026:

Cover letter that describes your interest in economic consulting and states your location preference
CV/resume
A writing sample/research paper 

 

Additional requirements:

If you are a recent graduate, 2-3 references or letters of recommendations should be sent to recruiting@brattle.com. Please note: No other application materials are accepted at this email address

 

Brattle offers a competitive benefits package, base salary, and bonus program for eligible roles based on individual and firm performance. The anticipated base gross salary for this position in Washington, D.C. is $230,000 annually. Actual salary will depend on a variety of factors, including experience and training.

 

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

The Brattle Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, citizenship status, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender identity and expression, age, height, weight, domestic partner status, Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome or HIV status (AIDS/HIV status), genetic information, sexual orientation, disability (where the applicant or employee is qualified to perform the essential functions of the job with or without reasonable accommodation), marital status, veteran status, political affiliation, drug or alcohol abuse or alcoholism, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.

 

We encourage all applicants to click here to review our full Equal Employer Opportunity Statement.

 

THE EMPLOYER

The Brattle Group answers complex economic, finance, and regulatory questions for corporations, law firms, and governments around the world. We are distinguished by the clarity of our insights and the credibility of our experts, which include leading international academics and industry specialists. Brattle has 500 talented professionals across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific. For more information, please visit brattle.com​.​​​​​

Associate, PhD - Early Decision (Finance/Crypto Focus) (2027)
New York, New York, United States
Apply

If you are certain that economic consulting is the career path you want to pursue, you should apply through our Early Decision process! If you want to explore other options before making a decision, we welcome you to apply through our regular process via the careers page of our website when the position is posted in October.

We commit to interviewing and making offer decisions to Early Decision candidates no later than December 18, 2026.
The deadline to submit your resume and cover letter to our website is Tuesday, October 13, 2026.
If you are offered a position via our Early Decision process, we will expect your final decision by January 3, 2027 prior to the AEA/ASSA meetings.
We are looking for both new graduates (those who are completing their PhDs by the summer of 2027) as well as experienced PhD’s who have been in the workplace (consulting, government, academia, industry, or other similar field) and are looking to make a change.

 

Associates at The Brattle Group

Associates work as part of a team on challenging and high-profile projects in a collegial and academically-oriented work environment. Brattle is large enough to be sought after to answer some of the most important complex economic, regulatory, and financial questions for clients around the world. We are also small enough to provide our Associates with individualized development and a variety of experiences from our experts. Associates are central members of each project team and apply finance and economic theory and practice to high-profile litigation, corporate strategy, regulation, and public policy issues on behalf of our clients.

Associates are responsible for framing research approaches, managing projects, and supervising team/staff while building individual expertise. As they gain valuable hands-on project experience, Associates also become more involved in developing client relationships and marketing and business development efforts. Brattle Associates benefit from continuous formal and informal training and development opportunities. Many of our Associates develop into Principals and testifying experts.

 

Ideal Candidates Will Possess

PhD in Finance, Financial Economics or related field with a strong foundation in quantitative analysis
Experience in computer science, data analysis, blockchain, and/or crypto markets
Pre- or postgraduate work experience in a related discipline (preferably in finance, government, related industry, or consulting) is strongly desired
Intellectual curiosity
Excellent analytic and quantitative skills (including proficiency with analytical/statistical software such as STATA, R, and Excel), along with practical problem-solving abilities
An entrepreneurial drive
Excellent relationship building skills
Demonstrated proficiency in written and oral communications
Desire to work in a collaborative team environment
Demonstrated record of outstanding academic and/or professional accomplishment

 

To be considered for the Associate position via the Early Decision process, please submit the following materials by Tuesday, October 13, 2026:

Cover letter that describes your interest in economic consulting and states your location preference
CV/resume
A writing sample/research paper 

 

Additional requirements:

If you are a recent graduate, 2-3 references or letters of recommendations should be sent to recruiting@brattle.com. Please note: No other application materials are accepted at this email address

 

Brattle offers a competitive benefits package, base salary, and bonus program for eligible roles based on individual and firm performance. The anticipated base gross salary for this position in New York, NY is $230,000 annually. Actual salary will depend on a variety of factors, including experience and training.

 

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

The Brattle Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, citizenship status, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender identity and expression, age, height, weight, domestic partner status, Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome or HIV status (AIDS/HIV status), genetic information, sexual orientation, disability (where the applicant or employee is qualified to perform the essential functions of the job with or without reasonable accommodation), marital status, veteran status, political affiliation, drug or alcohol abuse or alcoholism, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.

 

We encourage all applicants to click here to review our full Equal Employer Opportunity Statement.

 

THE EMPLOYER

The Brattle Group answers complex economic, finance, and regulatory questions for corporations, law firms, and governments around the world. We are distinguished by the clarity of our insights and the credibility of our experts, which include leading international academics and industry specialists. Brattle has 500 talented professionals across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific. For more information, please visit brattle.com​.​​​​​

Associate, PhD - Early Decision (Finance/Crypto Focus) (2027)
San Francisco, California, United States
Apply

If you are certain that economic consulting is the career path you want to pursue, you should apply through our Early Decision process! If you want to explore other options before making a decision, we welcome you to apply through our regular process via the careers page of our website when the position is posted in October.

We commit to interviewing and making offer decisions to Early Decision candidates no later than December 18, 2026.
The deadline to submit your resume and cover letter to our website is Tuesday, October 13, 2026.
If you are offered a position via our Early Decision process, we will expect your final decision by January 3, 2027 prior to the AEA/ASSA meetings.
We are looking for both new graduates (those who are completing their PhDs by the summer of 2027) as well as experienced PhD’s who have been in the workplace (consulting, government, academia, industry, or other similar field) and are looking to make a change.

 

Associates at The Brattle Group

Associates work as part of a team on challenging and high-profile projects in a collegial and academically-oriented work environment. Brattle is large enough to be sought after to answer some of the most important complex economic, regulatory, and financial questions for clients around the world. We are also small enough to provide our Associates with individualized development and a variety of experiences from our experts. Associates are central members of each project team and apply finance and economic theory and practice to high-profile litigation, corporate strategy, regulation, and public policy issues on behalf of our clients.

Associates are responsible for framing research approaches, managing projects, and supervising team/staff while building individual expertise. As they gain valuable hands-on project experience, Associates also become more involved in developing client relationships and marketing and business development efforts. Brattle Associates benefit from continuous formal and informal training and development opportunities. Many of our Associates develop into Principals and testifying experts.

 

Ideal Candidates Will Possess

PhD in Finance, Financial Economics or related field with a strong foundation in quantitative analysis
Experience in computer science, data analysis, blockchain, and/or crypto markets
Pre- or postgraduate work experience in a related discipline (preferably in finance, government, related industry, or consulting) is strongly desired
Intellectual curiosity
Excellent analytic and quantitative skills (including proficiency with analytical/statistical software such as STATA, R, and Excel), along with practical problem-solving abilities
An entrepreneurial drive
Excellent relationship building skills
Demonstrated proficiency in written and oral communications
Desire to work in a collaborative team environment
Demonstrated record of outstanding academic and/or professional accomplishment

 

To be considered for the Associate position via the Early Decision process, please submit the following materials by Tuesday, October 13, 2026:

Cover letter that describes your interest in economic consulting and states your location preference
CV/resume
A writing sample/research paper 

 

Additional requirements:

If you are a recent graduate, 2-3 references or letters of recommendations should be sent to recruiting@brattle.com. Please note: No other application materials are accepted at this email address

 

Brattle offers a competitive benefits package, base salary, and bonus program for eligible roles based on individual and firm performance. The anticipated base gross salary for this position in San Francisco, CA is $230,000 annually. Actual salary will depend on a variety of factors, including experience and training.

Sydney, New South Wales, Australia

Brattle Australia
The Brattle Group, a privately held, global economic consulting firm, is seeking an experienced Associate to join our growing securities practice in Sydney. For over a decade, Brattle’s Sydney office has been at the forefront of delivering market-leading corporate finance and economic consulting capabilities across Australia. As we continue to grow, we are looking for talented individuals to join our high-performing team. Our Australia-based professionals work side by side with clients to tackle their most complex challenges, developing novel and rigorous approaches that make a real impact. From assessing economic and commercial damages to shaping innovative solutions and bringing global insights to local markets, we are committed to delivering exceptional analysis and client service—and to building a team where you can do your best work.

Our Work

The Securities group at Brattle in Sydney works on complex, high-stakes disputes involving shareholder claims, regulatory investigations, and expert evidence. Our work includes analysing alleged corporate misconduct and disclosures, assessing materiality and investor impact, building trading and damages models, and critically evaluating opposing expert analyses. The team combines financial economics, accounting, and data analysis to quantify losses and support litigation strategy in fast-moving, high-profile cases.

The Role

Associates work as part of a team on challenging and high-profile projects in a collegial and fast-paced work environment. Brattle is sought after to answer complex financial, economic, and regulatory questions for clients around the world. You will have an opportunity to support our Principals, Academic Advisors, and Outside Experts as they serve as expert witnesses before courts and arbitration panels on behalf of law firms, corporations, and government agencies.

We provide our Associates with a variety of experiences and individualised development with increasing responsibilities. Associates are central members of each project team, and they apply finance, accounting, and economic concepts to help resolve high-profile engagements, including litigation, corporate strategy regulation, and public policy on behalf of our clients.

Associates are responsible for framing research approaches, managing projects, and supervising teams while building individual expertise. As they gain valuable hands-on project experience, Associates also become more involved in developing client relationships and marketing and business development efforts. Brattle Associates also benefit from continuous formal and informal training and development opportunities. Brattle is committed to being a multi-generational firm, with many of our Associates developing into Principals and testifying experts.



 

The ideal candidate will possess:

A PhD in Finance, Financial Economics, or Accounting or an MBA with an academic or professional background in Finance or Accounting
Excellent foundation in quantitative analysis, and/or several years of relevant work experience (preferably in economic consulting, public accounting, investment banking, or similar environment)
Proven project management skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with multiple stakeholders
Demonstrated record of outstanding academic and/or professional accomplishment
Intellectual curiosity, including a drive to think creatively about complex finance, valuation, business strategy, and accounting issues
Excellent analytic and quantitative skills, along with practical problem-solving abilities (including proficiency in Excel; experience with statistical software such as Stata or R also helpful)
An aptitude for, and interest in, expressing complex ideas through written reports and presentations
An entrepreneurial drive to build their own business and brand while contributing to the firm
Desire to work, learn, and lead within a collaborative team environment

 

To be considered for the Associate position, please submit the following materials via our website:

CV/resume
Cover letter (describing your interest in economic consulting)
Writing Sample
Transcripts from all university academic programs

 

THE EMPLOYER

The Brattle Group answers complex economic, finance, and regulatory questions for corporations, law firms, and governments around the world. We are distinguished by the clarity of our insights and the credibility of our experts, which include leading international academics and industry specialists. Brattle has 500 talented professionals across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific. For more information, please visit brattle.com​.​​​​​
